workflow: Distinguish native-chloride firing from imposed-chloride current in a developmental comparator for WWOX.
evidence_basis: Methods: cell-attached and whole-cell solutions, responder definition and comparison interval.
Results accompanying Figure 7: “20 (corresponding to 57%)” pyramidal responders; 3/15 assessable for inhibition. The separate basal subgroup description is arithmetically inconsistent.
Results accompanying Figure 8: “17 out of 30” interneurons responded. The 12 pyramidal neurons in the low-gabazine test were selected responders.
